sections.name: Event hero
sections.description: Conference or webinar hero: event-name eyebrow, tagline headline with one gradient accent, date and venue on one line directly under it, a single register CTA with a real price-deadline nudge, a three-stat scale band and a named speaker row. Webinar variant swaps the venue for online and caps the room instead of the rate.

usedBy.note: Name plus tagline, 'September 16-18, 2026 in Boston, MA', Register Now with a save-$200 price step, speaker carousel
Multi-edition event cards (SF June, India Oct), free virtual CTA alongside the in-person apply window
Date plus venue plus Get tickets, then a 3-stat scale band (250+ sessions, 6,500+ attendees, 150+ speakers)

props.title: Watch me rebalance a real budget in 30 minutes
props.sub: One live working session: I take a fictional quarter with real-shaped numbers, find the drift, and make the reallocation call on air. Bring questions.
props.urgency: I cap the room at 500 seats so every question gets answered.

sections.name: Community showcase
sections.description: Member-made highlights: a curated featured row of community playbooks, dashboards and templates, each carrying creator attribution and exactly one adoption number, above a join band with avatar proof and dual CTA. Pathways variant swaps the cards for entry points by commitment level: read, chat, meet, contribute.

usedBy.note: Card grid with creator avatar plus link and install count as the one proof number per card; curated Featured row above the browseable grid
Membership stat band and participation pathways by commitment level: Slack, forum, meetups, PRs

sections.name: Press band
sections.description: Newsroom strip: one featured announcement with kicker and excerpt, a plain dated list tagged by category (the list is a table, not more cards), and a sticky press-contact card with a media kit download. Compact variant collapses to the dated list plus an inline media kit link.

usedBy.note: Featured hero items, dated categorized feed mixing announcements with customer stories, media contact block with a real email
Large featured hero, secondary cards, then a searchable date / category / title table with See more
